% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): explicit limits, explicit ticks,
% width/height, labels, title and a major grid.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
  width=8cm, height=6cm,
  xmin=-1, xmax=5, ymin=0, ymax=10,
  xtick={-1,0,1,2,3,4,5},
  ytick={0,2.5,5,7.5,10},
  xlabel={Time $t$},
  ylabel={Signal},
  title={Explicit limits},
  grid=major,
]
\addplot coordinates {(-0.5,1) (0.5,4) (1.5,3.5) (2.5,8) (3.5,6) (4.5,9.5)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
